content.default:
Blacktop Restaurant Group wants everyone to be able to read about our restaurants, meet our team and find ways to work with us. This page explains how we approach accessibility on blacktoprestaurantgroup.com and what to do if something gets in your way.

Our commitment

We are working toward meeting the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA, which is the widely used standard for accessible websites. Accessibility is part of how we build and update pages, not an afterthought.

What we do

  • Pages use a clear structure of headings, so screen readers and keyboard users can move around.
  • Menus, buttons and links are built to be reached and used with a keyboard.
  • Photos that carry meaning get text descriptions; purely decorative artwork is hidden from assistive technology.
  • Text is sized to read comfortably, and pages reflow to fit phones and small screens.
  • Colors are chosen with contrast in mind, and we avoid relying on color alone to carry meaning.
  • Motion is kept to the brand's small animations. If your device is set to "reduce motion," the site turns animations off.

Where we know we fall short

We keep checking the site and fixing what we find, but some areas may not yet meet every guideline. Content added by people on our team, and parts supplied by other companies (embedded video, third-party job listings, social links), may not be fully accessible. If you hit a barrier, we want to know.

Tell us about a problem

If you can't use part of the site, can't find something, or would like information in another format, please tell us through the Contact page. Say which page and what happened, and what device or assistive technology you use if you can. We will reply as soon as we can, and fix the problem or get you the information another way.

Visiting our restaurants

This page is about the website. For questions about access at a specific restaurant, such as step-free entry, seating or menus in another format, please contact that restaurant directly or through our Contact page.

Keeping up

We review this statement and the site as we make changes, and whenever people tell us something isn't working. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.

look.label: Page look
look.doc: Dark is white words on black. Light is black words on white, with the colored underline. The menu at the top of the page follows.

uline_color.label: Underline color
uline_color.doc: The color of the hand-drawn underline under the title, and of the small highlights (the current menu item, link underlines).

numbers.label: Section numbers
numbers.doc: Small numbers (01, 02…) beside each section title and in the menu.

reading.label: How the sections open
reading.doc:
Click, as many as you like: nothing opens by itself; click a title to open it, and open as many as you want.
Click, one at a time: opening one closes the others.
Open as you scroll, stay open: each section opens when you reach it and stays open.
Open as you scroll, close the last: the section before it folds away.
All open: no rows, the whole policy shown.
The menu always opens the section it takes you to.

choices.click-many: Click, as many as you like
choices.follow: Open as you scroll, stay open
choices.follow-close: Open as you scroll, close the last

icons.label: Floating brand marks
icons.doc: A few of the brand marks float in a column down the right edge of a computer screen. They never sit over the words, so a phone does not show them.

icons_px.label: How much they drift
icons_px.doc: How far they move as you scroll, 0 (still) to 40.
